question: What is the admission process?
answer: Admission at MCE is available through CET (Government Quota) and Management (Non-Government Quota). For CET admission, the Common Entrance Test is conducted by the Department for Technical Education in Karnataka, and online application and seat allotment are processed by the KEA cell. Students selected for MCE can come directly to the college Admission Block with their Admission order.

question: How can I get admission through CET?
answer: Admission through CET (Govt. Quota) is through the Common Entrance Test (CET) conducted by the Department for Technical Education in Karnataka. Online application and seat allotment are processed by the KEA cell. Students who get selected for MCE can come directly to the college Admission Block with an Admission order.

question: Does MCE have management quota admission?
answer: Yes. MCE has admission through Management (Non-Govt. Quota). Management seats are allotted on a first come first serve basis. Applications for management seats are received at the MTES Office Hassan and seats are allotted.

question: Where do I apply for management quota admission?
answer: Applications for management seats are received at the MTES Office Hassan and seats are allotted on a first come first serve basis.

question: What are the eligibility requirements for admission?
answer: For B.E. admissions, MCE lists eligibility information based on the admission route and applicable rules. For the 2025-26 information published by MCE, B.E. aided courses list 10+2 with 45% plus UG CET. Candidates should check the latest MCE and KEA notification for the applicable academic year and category-specific requirements.

question: What documents are required for admission?
answer:
📄 Documents Required for Admission

Documents to be produced at the time of admission (KEA/COMED-K/D-CET):

1. KEA Confirmation Slip — 04 Xerox copies.

2. KEA CET/D-CET 2026 Online Application Form (Final Copy) — 02 Xerox copies.

3. KCET/COMED-K Allotment Order — 05 Xerox copies.

4. KCET/D-CET Verification Slip — 02 Xerox copies.

5. 12th (PUC) or Diploma Marks Card — 03 Xerox copies.

6. 10th (SSLC) Marks Card — 05 Xerox copies.

7. Caste & Income Certificate, if the seat has been allotted under any category — 03 Xerox copies.

8. Required certificates for applicable categories such as Rural Quota (10 years), Kannada Medium (10 years), Hyderabad Karnataka, Sports, Physically Handicapped, NCC, Defence and Ex-Defence — 03 Xerox copies.

9. KCET/COMED-K Admission Ticket — 03 Xerox copies.

10. KEA/COMED-K Fees Paid Challan — 03 Xerox copies.

11. Study Certificate with compulsory signature from BEO (minimum 7 years) — 02 Xerox copies.

12. Conduct Certificate from the institution last studied — 02 Xerox copies.

13. Transfer Certificate, if collected from the previous institution — 05 Xerox copies.

14. Recent passport-size colour photographs (5 nos.) — Original requirement; no Xerox copy specified.

15. Blood Group Report — No Xerox copy specified.

16. Aadhaar Card — 01 Xerox copy.

17. Student Digital Signature — No Xerox copy specified.

18. Affidavit by the Student — Format available on the college website.

19. Affidavit by Parent/Guardian — Format available on the college website.

📌 Important Notice:
Students are advised to keep soft copies of their original certificates and maintain ten sets of photocopies of all certificates for future requirements.

The original certificates will be deposited at the college office for the entire course duration of the next four years and returned upon completion of the program.

📌 Source: MCE Admission Information 2026-27

question: What documents are required for management quota admission?
answer:
📄 Management Quota Admission Documents

Documents to be produced at the time of admission under Management Quota:

1. SSLC Marks Card — 04 Xerox copies.

2. PUC Marks Card — 04 Xerox copies.

3. Study Certificate with compulsory signature from BEO (minimum 7 years) — 02 Xerox copies.

4. Transfer Certificate, if collected from the previous institution — 02 Xerox copies.

5. Conduct Certificate — 01 Xerox copy.

6. CET Admission Ticket or COMED-K Admission Ticket — 03 Xerox copies.

7. CET Rank proof or COMED-K Rank Proof — 03 Xerox copies.

8. Physical Fitness Certificate — No Xerox copy specified.

9. Blood Group Report — No Xerox copy specified.

10. Five colour passport-size photographs — No Xerox copy specified.

11. Aadhaar Card — 02 Xerox copies.

12. Bank demand draft for the prescribed amount in favour of Principal, Malnad College of Engineering, Hassan — No Xerox copy specified.

📌 Important Notice:
Students are advised to keep soft copies of their original certificates and maintain ten sets of photocopies of all certificates for future requirements.

The original certificates will be deposited at the college office for the next four years.

📌 Source: MCE Admission Information 2026-27
